title: Average score per course
statementMd:
For each course with graded enrollments show its title and average score rounded to 1 decimal. Highest first (ties by title).

Expected columns: `title`, `avg_score`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.title, ROUND(AVG(e.score), 1) AS avg_score FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id GROUP BY c.id, c.title ORDER BY avg_score DESC, c.title;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
